skills.name: product-excellence
skills.description: Turn product ideas, UX problems, and requested features into a clear user outcome and a complete, carefully designed path to it. Use when assessing what to build, improving an existing product journey, or implementing a feature that needs product judgment. Keep mechanical debugging, refactors, translation, and copy-only requests outside this workflow unless explicitly requested.

isolation: Separate test HOME and CODEX_HOME with an environment allowlist without credentials. Outbound connect/sendto/sendmsg/sendmmsg blocked by seccomp. Analytics and feedback disabled. No model or thread methods invoked.
scope: Final artifact filesystem discovery and metadata parsing, not model behavior.
redactions: Absolute environment paths replaced with test placeholders. Unrelated bundled skills, host identifiers, initialization details and notifications omitted.
